g.text: 1. Local Storage - It is similar to a disk storage with a capacity of 5-10MB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This is persistent meaning on refresh it stays

g.text: 2. Session Storage - It is related to the session only and as soon as the page reloads

g.text: it is recreated with new values

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Cookies - to store the information about preferences and session info into the browser.
